workshop.title: Workshop profile
workshop.setupDescription: Once your workshop is saved, buyers in your city can ask you to inspect cars.

status.label: Accept inspection requests
status.onDescription: Visible in search, rankings and on listings in {{city}}. Turn off when you're fully booked.
status.offDescription: Hidden from search, rankings and listings. Turn on to receive requests again.

identity.title: Identity
identity.logoHelper: JPG, PNG or WebP. Applied when you save.
identity.logoFailed: Your details are saved, but the logo didn't upload. Try again.
identity.name: Workshop name
identity.descriptionPlaceholder: Your experience, the brands you know best and what each inspection checks.

location.title: Location
location.description: Buyers see your workshop on listings in the same city.
location.hint: Click the map or drag the pin to your workshop entrance.
location.noPin: Click the map where your workshop is, or use your location.
location.pin: Your workshop. Use the arrow keys to move it.
location.pinRequired: Place the pin on your workshop.
location.denied: Location access is blocked. Allow it in your browser, or place the pin on the map.
location.unavailable: We couldn't find your location. Place the pin on the map instead.
location.unsupported: Your browser can't share its location. Place the pin on the map instead.
location.cityMatched: City set to {{city}}, where the pin is.
location.pinCleared: The pin was outside this city, so it was removed. Place it on your workshop again.
location.outsideCities: This spot isn't in a city on AutoSouk. Place the pin in your workshop's city.
location.unsaved: Position not saved yet. Click the button to keep it.

photos.title: Garage photos
photos.description: Show your lift, diagnostic tools and reception.
photos.afterSetup: You can add photos once your workshop is saved.

rankings.title: Best garages in <city>{{city}}</city>
rankings.rule: Garages are ranked by their average rating, then by their number of reviews. Only garages accepting requests are shown.

empty.title: No garage in {{city}} yet
empty.description: Garages appear here once they accept inspection requests. Try another city.

profile.notFound: This workshop doesn't exist or isn't visible right now.
profile.noPhotos: This workshop hasn't added photos yet.
profile.loginToRequest: Log in to request an inspection
profile.requestSentDescription: The workshop will accept or decline the inspection of {{car}}.
profile.noSavedCar: Save a car for sale in {{city}} to ask this workshop to inspect it.
profile.loginToReview: Log in to write a review
profile.noReviews: No reviews yet. Buyers who use this workshop can share how it went.

review.question: How was your inspection?
review.ratingRequired: Choose a rating from 1 to 5 stars.
review.helper: Keep it respectful: reviews with offensive language are blocked automatically.
review.deleteDescription: Your rating and words leave this workshop's page. You can write a new review later.
